label: About
title: About Forgiven Game Surface
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 528 recent saved-signal files and 158 captured links, then narrowed the page to 8 source windows around @GORMTHEOLD25: Forgive me Nintendo for I have sinned. and @Replicante97: tweet 2089653074591637909, plus 6 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Forgiven Game Surface: Forgiven game-surface rupture: a wide game-space surface compressed into shallow macro, with three lower bands of aliased moss, teal water, and distant pale slab geometry under huge blue sky. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 8 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against ragged upper smoke tear, split tower seam, and left rider-and-shield aperture.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
